location: Franklin County, Vermont, USA (exact location withheld; no landowner relationship or site access)

data.land_cover: NLCD 2021 Cultivated Crops (class 82), MRLC WMS, 5 m resample of 30 m data
data.soils: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access; dominant major component per map unit

soils.map_unit: Peru fine sandy loam, 3 to 15 percent slopes, very stony
Eldridge loamy fine sand, 8 to 15 percent slopes
Munson silt loam, 8 to 15 percent slopes

soc_method: SSURGO dominant major component per map unit; SOC = OM*0.58*BD*thickness (van Bemmelen factor); AWS = AWC*thickness; point-sample area weights (60 points)
soc_adjustment: Peru map unit O horizon (80% OM, 0-3 cm) excluded for cultivated land: 114.9 tC/ha used instead of 151.3
not_observed: tree growth and all process rates
